2026-09: One month at Acme Signals, a fictional company: its business figures, which are synthetic and invented for teaching, and the release of its model live that month, measured on real bank data.
Acme Signals is a fictional company.
Its business figures below (customers, pilots, revenue and contacts ranked) are invented for teaching by scripts/make_synthetic_business.py; they are not real company data.
Paying customers (banks): 6 (synthetic), up from 4 (synthetic) in August 2026.
Monthly recurring revenue: £21,000 (synthetic), up from £14,000 (synthetic) in August 2026.
Contacts ranked for customers and pilots: 123,357 (synthetic), up from 91,418 (synthetic) in August 2026.
The business figures of Acme Signals, a fictional company, for August 2026 and September 2026, from data/synthetic_business.csv.
They are not real company data.
The model’s figures are real: scripts/evaluate.py computes them on the public UCI Bank Marketing data, 11,303 contacts held out from training.
The company and its releases are fictional, and each release is measured by today’s evaluation, on the same held-out contacts.
The release live in September 2026 was v3 (gradient-boosted trees on every field known before the call), released in September 2026 and the best-ranking release so far.
Its ROC AUC is 0.799 (95% interval 0.785 to 0.813), and calling the top 10% of its list reaches 43.6% of the subscribers, 4.4 times as many per call as calling at random.
It replaced v2, and its ROC AUC, 0.799, is above the 0.772 of v2.
